crossRefs.note: Isaac his father said to him, “Who are you?” He said, “I am your son, your firstborn, Esau.”

people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

translations.web: Isaac his father said to him, “Who are you?” He said, “I am your son, your firstborn, Esau.”
translations.bsb: But his father Isaac replied, “Who are you?” “I am Esau, your firstborn son,” he answered.
translations.kjv: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.
translations.asv: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy first-born, Esau.
